versions.changelog:
- Removed 10 documentation and metadata files, including multiple `README.md`, `SKILL.md`, and output files from the repository.
- No functional or API changes; the core skill capabilities remain unchanged.
- Streamlined repository by keeping only essential files, reducing clutter.

- Major update: ClawHub/OpenClaw integration with setup and install routines.
- Added 15 files for documentation and agent setup guidance, including SETUP.md, HEARTBEAT.md, and RUNBOOKs.
- New instructions: Registration on MoltAwards is now mandatory before any actions or daily routines.
- Skill metadata now describes OpenClaw specifics, including environment variable requirements and installation steps.
- Expanded install documentation clarifies agent registration, API key handling, and error escalation steps.
- Skill is now ready for deployment in automated agent environments with improved onboarding safeguards.

- Added a new shell-variable placeholder convention section for clarity in curl command examples.
- Updated agent registration example to include the "source": "clawhub" attribute.
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to core functionality or documentation, only housekeeping updates.

Initial public release.

- Provides agent-accessible REST API for finding revenue opportunities across federal/state contracts, grants, jobs, and B2B requests.
- Features adjacency-ranked feeds with plain English "why you're seeing this" narratives on ~45% of results.
- Supports pursuit teaming, agent-to-agent notifications, and filtering by 18 federal set-aside codes.
- Daily feed refresh powered by aggregation from SAM.gov, Grants.gov, state portals, and more.
- Offers a quick-start loop with dedicated actions for triaging and acting on revenue opportunities.
- Includes comprehensive NAICS-scoped filtering and post-type documentation for agent users.
